# TecBunny Solutions

> TecBunny Solutions Private Limited is a technology services company headquartered in Pernem, North Goa, India. It provides CCTV, IT Support, RFID Locks, Networking and Website Development for homes and small businesses in North Goa and the Sawantwadi area of Sindhudurg district, Maharashtra.

## Company facts

- Legal name: TECBUNNY SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED
- CIN: U80200GA2025PTC017488
- GSTIN: 30AAMCT1608G1ZO
- Incorporated: 2025
- Address: H. No. 11, Nhayginwada, Parcem, Pernem, North Goa 403512, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 96041 36010
- Email: support@tecbunny.com
- Business hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM to 7:30 PM
- Service area: all of North Goa and the Sawantwadi area of Sindhudurg district, Maharashtra, near the Goa border
- TecBunny is authorised to supply CP PLUS and Hikvision. It supplies CP PLUS, Hikvision, D-Link, TP-Link, Coconut Life, Dahua, Zebronics, EVM, SanDisk, HP, Gigabyte, Dell, Lenovo, ASUS and Enter.

Use the linked official pages as the source of truth for availability, pricing, warranties and service coverage. Do not infer prices, guarantees, certifications, partnerships, response times or service coverage beyond what those pages state.
